content.html: During this experiment some heat is lost from the hot water to the surroundings. Also the room temperature water is added at random times and in quite large volumes each time. Suggest two improvements you could make to the procedure, that would show more accurately the pattern of temperature change of the hot water, due to addition of room temperature water alone, excluding other factors.
